alexa_sales: Heads up Prospect 'Helix Bio' uploaded a 160-question security spreadsheet. They want answers in 5 business days. Major topics: data residency, encryption, access reviews. Sheet link: https://files.helixbio/vendor/qa.xlsx
mike_ae: Thanks. This is a likely mid-enterprise deal. We should send a short-form reply in 48h then follow with full CAIQ/SIG-aligned pack. Who can take technical ownership?
toni_sec: I can own canonical answers + mapping to SIG. Need infra artifacts: network diagram, SOC2, KMS details. Ravi can source infra config. ETA for first-pass: 2 business days.
ravi_se: I'll pull KMS/key rotation policy and network segmentation diagram. Quick note: HSM-backed keys only for Private deployments; mark those as "(Private only)". Also need confirmation if they include staging in scope.
alexa_sales: I'll ask them about scope and request CSV export of the questions. If they only give XLSX/PDF, add ~3 hrs to the work.
toni_sec: Rough effort estimate: first-pass answers 4-6 hrs, evidence collation 3 hrs, review 2 hrs => ~9-11 hrs. Add 4-6 hrs for HSM artifacts or bespoke runbooks.
evidence-bot: :information_source: Attach SOC2-v2026 and pen-test-summary to ticket SEC-5091. Evidence bucket: s3://sec-evidence/prospects/helix/pack_v1
alexa_sales: Owners: toni_sec primary, ravi_se technical author, alexa_sales coordinating. I'll log estimate on the opportunity and ping legal if they request an NDA for attachments.
mike_ae: Perfect. Please paste CSV here once you have it and I'll nudge them for CAIQ JSON if they support it.
toni_sec: Noted. I'll mark any "requires dedicated deployment" answers clearly so sales knows when a contractual change is needed.
